name_en: Obiten — deep-fried fish cake bound with tofu and sweetened with brown sugar
summary_ja: イワシやアジなどの近海魚をすり身にして豆腐と合わせ、味噌や黒砂糖で味付けして揚げる日南市飫肥の練り物。江戸期の飫肥藩で考え出されたとされ、薩摩揚げに似るが豆腐入りでふわりとやわらかいのが持ち味。
summary_en: Sardine, horse mackerel, and other coastal fish are ground into surimi, mixed with tofu, seasoned with miso and brown sugar, and deep-fried — a fish cake from the Obi district of Nichinan, said to have been devised under the Edo-era Obi domain; it resembles satsuma-age but stays softer and fluffier for the tofu folded in.
source_title: おび天 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
